Residual (non-blocking, out of issue scope): Lua is_allowed_args is not metatable-hardened. Lua 5.4 pairs() honors __pairs and indexing honors __index, so a table such as setmetatable({status},{__pairs=...}) can hide a trailing denied flag from dense_string_count (rawget only guards the counted range). Not exploitable today: args are always internal literals in init.lua, and the host bridge (bitty/crates/bitty-lua/src/host.rs:1098-1152) marshals raw table pairs (metatables ignored per config.rs:12-24) then re-enforces a dense 1-based string-array shape plus the canonical host allowlist. Optional follow-up: reject any table with a metatable (getmetatable(args) ~= nil) and/or iterate with next() instead of pairs().
